headline: Denied a 15 Ward Street driveway and curb cut license request, and approved a housing infrastructure agreement with Watershed A, LLC.
summary: Residents spoke at the public forum and at a public hearing on planBTV: New North End. Work sessions covered legislative priorities and problem properties. A resolution supporting graduate student workers at the University of Vermont passed 9-2-1. A unanimous consent agenda included a $1,470,800 SS4A Main Street Signals budget and up to $40,000 in community celebrations grants.
decisions: Failed to refer the 15 Ward Street driveway and curb cut application to the License Committee, 2-9-1.
Denied the application for 15 Ward Street to keep using a curb cut and driveway, 9-2-1.
Approved the housing infrastructure agreement with Watershed A, LLC, unanimously.
Adopted the resolution in support of graduate student workers at the University of Vermont, 9-2-1.
Adopted the consent agenda and the actions listed on it, unanimously.
